Display retrieved inputs as text in ui-testapp (#9409)

The ui-testapp onExecuteAction handler now writes the retrieved
inputs/URL JSON via textContent instead of innerHTML, builds the
OpenUrl output with JSON.stringify, and drops the pass-through
TrustedTypes policy that is no longer needed.
